messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT: sudden spike in frontend gateway timeouts and 5xx for /v1/generate — 5m error rate 8.2% (baseline 0.3%), p95 latency 1.8s -> 5.6s, p99 3.2s -> 12.1s. Source: prod-eu cluster. Deploy suspected (deploy-2026-03-14-1145). @alex is oncall.

alex: ack — looking now. Can someone post the deploy id and rollout window?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: deploy-2026-03-14-1145 by sarah. Canary 10% -> 100% finished at 11:45:12 UTC. Rollout metadata: image: inference-runtime:v3.8.3-quant, route: hosted-api, region: eu-west-1.

sarah: I pushed a small optimizer change to the runtime kernel selection. Rolling back if needed.

alex: quick checks — traces show requests stalling on `kv_cache.populate()` and many upstream 504s from backend-gateway. Opening targeted logs.

mike: seeing similar in us-east-1 but smaller amplitude; eu is worst. p50 unchanged, p95/p99 blown. 5xx types: 502 gateway, 504 timeout.

linda: adding runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/timeout-regression|timeout regression runbook> — follow rollback path if deploy suspected.

alex: running `kubectl get pods -l svc=hosted-api -n prod -o wide` to check rollout status.

alex: result: new pod set (rt-v3.8.3) at 100% of replicas, readiness probes passing but steady stream of timeouts in app logs.

mike: capturing a sample stack trace from app logs:
```
2026-03-14T11:52:03Z ERROR request_id=abc123 timeout while awaiting kv_cache.populate shard=12 latency_ms=5023
2026-03-14T11:52:04Z WARN upstream gateway 10.2.3.45 responded 504 after 5001ms
```

alex: hypothesis: new kernel path increased tail latency for cold KV cache paths. Could be blocking on a sync path under load.

sarah: I can roll back immediately. Would rather not let customer errors sit. Any objections?

linda: :thumbsup: do it. Notify SRE before rollback? We'll need to watch fallback behavior.

mike: if we rollback, recommend partial rollback first (50%) to confirm improvement on canaries, then full. But given error rate, I support immediate full rollback with rapid monitoring.

alex: agreed. Rolling back to inference-runtime:v3.8.2 now. /deploy rollback deploy-2026-03-14-1145 -> deploy-2026-03-14-1145-rollback initiated by alex.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: deploy-2026-03-14-1145-rollback. Target image: inference-runtime:v3.8.2. Estimated duration: ~3m.

oncall-rotation: paging follow-up: @sarah will own postmortem, @mike to run perf instrumentation, @linda to check customer impact and comms.

alex: prometheus graph: within 90s of rollback start p99 drops from ~12s -> ~1.3s, error rate from 8.2% -> 0.4% after pods replaced. Confirming in eu-west-1.

incident-bot: Deployment rollback completed at 11:55:30 UTC. Canary checks OK.

mike: running `curl -v` to a few endpoints shows normal latencies now, sample output:
```
> GET /v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< x-request-latency-ms: 24
```

alex: Customers impacted: burst of 5xx/timeouts affecting ~0.6% of total requests during outage window 11:50:00-11:55:30 UTC, primarily small batch realtime traffic in eu. No billing anomalies detected; we are evaluating any API key errors.

sarah: I've opened INC-2026-1741 and added initial timeline + deploy diff. Will follow up with a detailed postmortem.

linda: I pinged Support to surface any customer-reported incidents; Support will update if tickets come in.

oncall-rotation: Handoff: alex, please summarize for next oncall in case of late regression.

alex: Summary for handoff: cause suspected kernel/kv_cache path change in v3.8.3 causing tail blocking under certain seq-length distributions. Rolled back to v3.8.2. Monitoring shows metrics recovered. Action items: reproduce in staging with similar traffic shape (mike), audit kernel selection fallback logic (sarah), add guardrails to canary rollout (linda).

mike: I'll run stress test against a staging cluster with v3.8.3 and long-tail prompt patterns. ETA 6h.

sarah: I'll add a feature flag for the optimizer path and limit canary to 5% until validated.

linda: I'll draft a short customer note for Support and add to the incident ticket.

alex: closing incident thread here. If anything regresses re-ping #oncall. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1741 created and assigned. Timeline: 11:45 deploy, 11:50 elevated errors detected, 11:52 root cause suspected, 11:53 rollback started, 11:55 rollback completed, 11:56 service recovered.

linda: adding retrospective placeholder: "avoid full 100% rollouts for runtime kernel changes until expanded canary+stress validation".

sarah: noted. Will add tests and move slower next canary.

mike: thumbs up. I'll post results of staging repro and attach traces in the ticket.

alex: thanks team. Good mitigation speed.

linda: :coffee:
